Search, pick a version, install."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Or install by hand with the same specs the index lists:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What's inside"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Plugin | What it does | Install |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| **Share Link** `@vlln/dsh-share-link` | Publish a conversation or an artifact as a read-only publi"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"c link; revoke anytime. | `github:vlln/dsh-share-link` |
| **Video to Text** `dsh-video2text` | Vide"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"o link → script: sidebar player, transcript, export; bundles the `video2text` skill. | `github:vlln/"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"dsh-video2text` |
| **Pancha** `dsh-pancha` | A directory as a board you can audit, annotate and act"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" on — the agent labels, you decide. | `github:vlln/dsh-pancha` |
| **Loop** `@vlln/dsh-loop` | Sched"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"uled loops: `/loop` command, `loop` tool and a live activity bar. | `@vlln/dsh-loop` |
| **Auto Fork"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"** `@vlln/dsh-autofork` | When the agent is busy, fork the session: the new instruction runs now, th"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"e old turn reports back later. | `github:vlln/dsh-autofork` |
| **Whale Girl** `whale-girl` | A desk"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"top pet for the DSH Web GUI. | `whale-girl` |
| **Evolution Engineering** `@vlln/evo-engineering` | "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"Improve any artifact in rounds: standard, iterate, independent review, rollback. | `github:vlln/evo-"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"engineering` |
| **PR Inbox** `dsh-pr-inbox` | A sidebar panel for the GitHub PRs that concern you: "},{"id":"p13s12","text":"opened, to review, merged — over your local `gh` login. | `github:omdsh-dev/dsh-pr-inbox` |
| **Pres"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"et Inspector** `dsh-preset-inspector` | See where every line of an agent preset comes from: patch la"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"yer, package, config. | `github:omdsh-dev/dsh-preset-inspector` |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Archived"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Still installable by name, just no longer maintained — so they are not in the index."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Plugin | What it does | Install |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| **Navbar** `@vlln/dsh-navbar` | A node rail on the conversation's right edge: jump between user me"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ssages. | `@vlln/dsh-navbar` |
| **Task Status** `@vlln/dsh-task-status` | A status bar for backgrou"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"nd jobs: per-task progress plus a live output tail. | `@vlln/dsh-task-status` |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How this repo works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Path | Role |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `plugins/*.json` | Hand-written display facts only: title, description, category, keywords, icon |"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"
| `scripts/build-index.mjs` | Probes the real facts (npm versions + publish times, or the default-b"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ranch HEAD commit and its manifest), merges, validates with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index`, "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"writes `index.json` |
| `index.json` | The generated index — the only file a client reads |
| `.gith"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ub/workflows/index.yml` | Daily rebuild; commits only when `index.json` actually changed |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Versions are what is actually published: npm-published plugins list their npm versions, git-only plu"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"gins list the
default-branch HEAD commit. When a repo is ahead of npm, the index keeps the published"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" version — install from git if
you want the bleeding edge."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## History"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Until 2026-10-03 this repo hosted a **thin console** (a browser panel managing a profile's plugin in"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"stall state) and a
copy of the `make-dsh-plugin` skill. DSH's own Plugins page took over the console"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"'s job, the skill moved to
